PART 03

阅读

20 题 · 共 35 分

第一节 阅读理解（21—35，每题 2 分）。

SUNSHINE MIDDLE SCHOOL · AFTER-SCHOOL CLUBS

ClubDayTimePlaceActivity
Reading ClubMonday & Wednesday4:30—5:30LibraryShare stories, write book reviews
Basketball ClubTuesday & Thursday4:30—6:00PlaygroundPractise and play matches
Nature ClubFriday4:30—5:30School gardenWatch birds and plants, keep a notebook
Art ClubWednesday4:30—5:30Art roomDraw and paint posters
Music ClubFriday5:00—6:00Music roomSing and play the piano

Come and join us! Sign up at the school office before 20 September. Each student can join two clubs.

（B）

At my old school, I was very shy. I had only one friend, and I never put up my hand in class. This September, I came to a new school in Guangzhou. Everything was new: the buildings, the teachers and even the food.

On my first day, I sat alone at lunch. A girl with short hair came over and put her tray (餐盘) next to mine. “Hi, I'm Chen Jie. You're new, right?” she said. Before I could answer, she began to tell me about her favourite teachers and the best food in the dining hall. I laughed for the first time that week.

After lunch, Chen Jie showed me around the school. She took me to the library, the playground and the art room. She also invited me to the Reading Club. On Wednesday, I had to read a story aloud in front of the club. My hands were cold and my voice was low. Chen Jie looked at me and smiled. “Take your time,” she said quietly. I finished the story. Some students clapped (鼓掌).

Now I am not afraid of speaking in class. I have five good friends, and Chen Jie is one of them. I learn from her that a true friend does not just wait for you. She walks to you first.

（C）

The Earth is about 4.6 billion years old. It is the only planet we know that has life. From space, it looks like a blue ball, because about 71% of it is covered by water.

The Earth gives us everything we need. Forests give us clean air and homes for animals. Rivers and lakes give us fresh water. Soil (土壤) helps plants grow, and plants give us food. Without these, people cannot live.

But the Earth is facing problems. Factories and cars make the air and water dirty. People cut down too many trees. Every year, millions of plastic bags go into the sea, and fish eat them by mistake. The weather is also changing. Summers are getting hotter, and rains are getting heavier.

However, small actions can make a big difference. We can turn off the lights when we leave a room. We can reuse bottles and paper. We can ride a bike or take a bus to school. We can also plant a tree on Tree Planting Day. If everyone does a little, the Earth will be a better place for all living things.

第二节 信息匹配（36—40，每题 1 分）：为五位同学匹配最合适的俱乐部，选项中有一项多余。

A. In this club, you read books and share stories with others. You can also write your own story and put it in the school magazine.

B. This club is for students who love ball games. You practise after school and play matches against other classes.

C. If you enjoy nature, join us. We watch birds and plants in the school garden and keep a notebook about them.

D. In this club, you draw and paint. You also make posters for school events.

E. Do you like music? Come and sing with us. You can also learn to play the piano.

F. This club is for students who like cooking. You learn to make simple dishes and talk about healthy food.

PART 04

读写综合

5 题 · 每题 2 分 · 共 10 分

阅读短文，用英语回答问题。机器判分按关键词，意思对但表述不同，可以对照参考答案自行勾选。

Many people love bright lights at night. They think lights make cities beautiful. But too much light is bad for animals. Baby sea turtles (海龟) are a good example. They are born on beaches at night. They need to find the sea. They use the bright moon and stars to guide them. But if there are many bright lights from buildings near the beach, the baby turtles become confused (困惑的). They go the wrong way. They may walk onto the road and be killed. This is a big problem in some places.

We can help. We can turn off some lights near the beach at night. We can use yellow lights. They are not as bright as white lights. We can also tell people about this problem. Small changes can save many baby turtles. The Earth is our home. We should care for all living things.
